name: inspira-dock
blurb: Dock with magnification on mouse proximity, customizable orientation.
description: Dock component (inspira-react) with hover magnification. Supports vertical or horizontal orientation. Customizable distance and magnification factor.
use_when: Floating action menus or toolbars where magnification polish matters.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces; magnification requires pointer tracking.
a11y: Dock items are keyboard-focusable. Icons have aria-label. Magnification is visual; doesn't affect usability.
